title: Evaluating the Safety of Zileuton (Zyflo®) in Combination With Dasatinib (Sprycel®) in Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia

sections.abstract: Prospective nonrandomized phase I study The purpose of this study is to determine safety and efficacy of zileuton when added to dasatinib in patients with chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML).
